Does C1 alone establish "then published a journal article..."? No. C3 alone doesn't establish six years after book. But the instruction: "Which current Verified Claims provide substantive evidentiary support for one fixed Parent Requirement." Likely both C1 and C3 are needed. The question asks return support_claim_ids. They can be multiple. So include C1 and C3? C1 is about book; C3 about article. The parent requirement is about the action of publishing journal article six years after book. To support, need both facts. C1 provides book and year/topic. C3 provides article and year/topic. C2 not relevant. So answer ["C1","C3"].

But check if C1 also establishes book "exploring the singularity between Vipassana and Mathematics" which is similar topic to article? C3 article title "Finding the mathematical overlaps of the axiom of choice in Vipassana meditation" yes similar topic: mathematics and Vipassana. C1 provides book publication date Nov 15, 2016.
